pages.text: Spring rain had fallen for three days. The path outside the yard was all mud. Grandma brought an armful of dry branches.
"I'll play at the stream when the rain stops." "Then let's lay branches on the path today." "I'll do it later."
Yuki rolled around in the room. Rain streamed beyond the window. "I can do it tomorrow."
Momo went outside and came back, shaking off their paws. "You're dirty, Momo."
More rain fell all night. In the morning, Yuki opened the door. The path looked soft and squishy.
Yuki took one step. Their foot sank deep.
Pulling the foot out left one shoe in the mud. Yuki stood barefoot. "My shoe!"
Grandma stirred through the mud with a long branch and fished out the shoe. She set it before Yuki.
Yuki brought an armful of branches and laid them along the path. "Will this be enough?"
Yuki walked over the branches, crunch, crunch. Even all the way to the stream, the shoes stayed clean.
